lines.text: Where is or where it is?
Many learners say: Please tell me where is the restroom.
Better: Please tell me where the restroom is.
After tell me, use normal order.
She is! Tell me where she is.

data.wrong: Please tell me where is the restroom.
data.right: Please tell me where the restroom is.
data.why: After tell me, use normal order.

native.tip: После “tell me” порядок обычный: “Please tell me where the restroom is.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “Please tell me where is the restroom”? 😅 По-русски «скажи, где туалет» — порядок такой же, как в вопросе, и английский строят так же, но после “tell me” нужен обычный порядок слов. Правильно: “Please tell me where the restroom is.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “she is.” После tell me — обычный порядок. Скажи вслух: “Please tell me where the … is.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After “tell me”, use normal order: “Please tell me where the restroom is.”
en.caption: Do you also say “Please tell me where is the restroom”? 😅 In Russian the order stays the same as in a question, so people copy it, but after “tell me” English needs normal order. Correct: “Please tell me where the restroom is.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
